summary: Iteration 15: tested the seminar signup API (6/6 pytest pass) and all 4 user items on a 375px mobile web viewport. ITEM1: the Goa card now shows an image, but it is the IPHM accreditation logo cropped to 'HM ... Accre', not a seminar photo. ITEM2: the training calendar marks Nov 6-8 and 28-29, Dec 5-6 and Feb 8-14 2027. Tapping a Goa day's featured card opens /article/7317. ITEM3/3b: section order is right on both pages, each seminar appears once (Goa x1, 28&29 x1, 5&6 Dec x1), the archives (training 8, events 4) have no duplicates, and BlogList shows only the Άρθρα grid. ITEM4: joining from the seminar page works (label changes, '· Ακύρωση' hint shows). Profile 'Οι εκδηλώσεις μου' shows the row with date and location and the chip 'Επόμενη: σε 17 ημέρες'. Tapping the row opens the seminar, and canceling removes it from the profile. ITEM4b: joining from the Goa article shows 'σε 89 ημέρες'. ITEM4c: logged-out tap goes to /login. EN label is 'Register your spot'. Bug: the join button also shows on PAST dated articles. No deprecated Expo packages in the files reviewed.

minor.issue: '31 Οκτ & 1 Νοεμ' is parsed as event_end=2026-10-31. The cross-month end date is lost, so Nov 1 is not marked and the archive shows only '31 Οκτωβρίου 2026'.
ref is a path segment; a ref containing '/' would break deletion (current refs are slugs or 'article-<id>', so this is a latent risk only).

ui_bugs.issue: 'Δήλωση συμμετοχής' renders on PAST dated training/event articles (verified /article/6508 6-8 Nov 2026 and /article/6005 Oct 2025), so users can register for seminars that already ended. The condition at ArticleReader.tsx:91 checks only event_start + category; it should also require (event_end||event_start) >= athensToday(). SeminarDetail correctly checks t.active.

integration_issues.flow: Join same seminar from two sources
integration_issues.issue: Catalog seminar uses ref=<slug>, but its blog copy (e.g. 28&29 Νοε = article 7256 / 7067) uses ref=article-<id>. Opening the article and joining creates a second signup for the same seminar, so the profile can show duplicates. Consider reusing the schedule de-dup key (end_date|level) as the ref, or checking it.

issues: The Goa image is the IPHM accreditation logo, cropped by resizeMode cover to 'HM ... Accre'. It reads as broken, not as a photo. Prefer a real photo, or use resizeMode contain on a neutral background.
At 375px the heading wraps to 2 lines ('Οι εκδηλώσεις / μου') because of the countdown chip. Allow the chip to drop below the heading, or shrink it.

The calendar uses mode='all', so it shows trainings (featured 'Level 1 · Αθήνα', 'Επερχόμενα 3'), while the list below says 'Δεν υπάρχουν ενεργές εκδηλώσεις αυτή τη στιγμή.' This is confusing; consider mode='events' or a clearer label.

action_items: Hide JoinButton in ArticleReader.tsx when the article's event has ended ((event_end||event_start) < athensToday()).
Prevent duplicate signups for the same seminar via catalog slug vs blog article-<id> ref.
Fix the blog date parser for cross-month ranges like '31 Οκτ & 1 Νοεμ' (event_end should be 2026-11-01).
Replace or contain the Goa fallback image (accreditation logo is cropped).

Optional: schedule.ts wantGreek is hard-coded true, so EN users get the Greek copy in the calendar. Use the current language as the agent note intended. useSchedule's loading also ignores blog.loading.
critical_code_review_comments: schedule.ts:154 const wantGreek = true ignores the UI language ('current language preferred' is not implemented).
schedule.ts:192 loading excludes blog.loading, so the 'no dates' text can flash while the blog loads.
JoinButton swallows GET errors silently; if the list fails it shows 'Δήλωση συμμετοχής' even if already joined (re-POST is idempotent, so this is harmless).
MySeminars returns null on load error with no error state.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows pass; 1 bug: join button on past articles)

seed_data_creation: None persisted. Maria's signups were joined then canceled; final state is [] (verified). The pytest TEST_ref_* signups are deleted.

Calendar day buttons have aria-label '<day>, N εκδήλωση/εις'; month arrows are labeled 'Επόμενος μήνας'/'Προηγούμενος μήνας'.
